paragraphs: The XJ Super V8 was the flagship petrol model of the X350 generation, produced from 2002 to 2009. It used the supercharged 4.0-litre AJ-V8 — the same engine family that powered the XJR of the same era, tuned for the XJ's more refined character. The X350 was the first XJ to use an aluminium monocoque chassis, significantly lighter than previous steel-bodied XJs. The XJ Super V8 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. About the AJ-V8 Supercharged Engine AJ-V8 supercharged (X350) A 4.0-litre supercharged V8 fitted to the XJ Super V8 across the entire X350 generation (2002–2009). cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XJ Super V8 from 2023 to present. The AJ-V8 supercharged features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ-V8 supercharged V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ-V8 supercharged rebuild.
